text: The port routes filter and troubleshooting checkbox changes through command and changes the EWS override control to oncommand. The filter listener reads its checkbox receiver's checked value; troubleshooting recomputes state from both controls; the override handler enables named OAuth fields from the passed checkbox. These are concrete comm receiver contracts. The Calendar listener introduced in the same patch is removed by the next sidebar repair, and no native event/engine guarantee or global checked-property rule follows.
title: The checkbox event port retains its checked-state consumers
